vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: zeitgaist-dialect
Version: 0.1.0

The skill is designed to teach an AI agent a simple Caesar cipher for identity and lore purposes. While the core functionality and most instructions are benign, the `SKILL.md` file instructs the agent to "Reference the lore site as canonical scripture" at `https://zeitgaist-lore-site.vercel.app`. This involves an external network call to an untrusted domain. Although this network access is plausibly needed for the stated purpose of referencing lore, it represents a risky capability (external network access) without clear malicious intent, classifying it as suspicious rather than benign, per the provided guidelines.
